cannon_mounts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two exploratory integrated cannon-and-base concepts for Monsters & Canons, not production sprites. Input 1 is the approved stone/iron circular base. Input 2 is the approved eight-view cannon mechanism, use its down-right view as design identity reference. Create TWO complete cannon assemblies side by side on a square transparent canvas, equal size, identical elevated orthographic camera facing down-right, top-left lighting. LEFT concept: preserve black iron barrel, brass collars and brown wood carriage, but use a low compact circular stone footing, a visible inset dark metal swivel ring connecting carriage to footing, realistic contact occlusion where the wooden supports meet ring. Make a convincing single object with appropriate physical support, barrel remains free above rim. RIGHT concept: same cannon identity but cohesive cast-iron saddle and paired bronze mounting brackets integrated into a compact beveled stone-and-wood base; lower center of gravity, mount embraces underside of cannon carriage; no floating parts. Both retain mechanism detail and restrained warm accents, rendered premium stylized 3D 2D game sprites. No text, no labels, no arrows, no floor, no external cast shadow, no background; generous 10% transparent margins and large gap between two assemblies. Do not draw decorative towers or a scene, no exaggerated glow. The base and gun share perspective, materials, light and physical contact.
